newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end up, seen flat ahead of expiry.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end up, seen flat ahead of expiry.

text.p: Austrian shares ended mixed on Wednesday after drifting sideways for most of the session, and traders said they expected the index to remain rangebound until the expiry of futures and options on Friday.
"We've first got to get over the expiry and then it will head back up," said one.
The index was seen trapped in a 1,060-to-1,080-point range.
"Many contracts are open at 1,080, but we won't go over that level," another trader said.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips inched up 2.79 points or 0.26 percent to 1,075.69. Among its constituents 13 shares rose, seven fell and one remained unchanged.

Demand was particularly strong in shares in oil and chemicals concern OMV and engineering group VA Technologie, traders said. VA Technologie shares hit a new year high of 1,558.95 at the close of trade -- a jump of 12.95 schillings.
Overall luxury hosiery maker Wolford was the top gainer, climbing 14 schillings to 1,380.
The leading decliner of the session was papermaker Leykam, tumbling eight schillings to 283.
The November ATX future added 3.4 points to 1,078.0.
The broad-based Vienna Bourse index rose 0.78 points or 0.19 percent to 412.89.
